## Source discovery and audits

Six fresh candidates were screened beyond the prior queue: English Wikisource, Project Runeberg, StoryWeaver, Lit2Go, Perseus Digital Library, and the Baen Free Library. Four received a full admission audit; the remaining two received a bounded rights/access screen sufficient to defer them safely.

### English Wikisource — pass as link-only discovery

English Wikisource's current licensing policy requires hosted works to be in the public domain or under a compatible free-content license and requires source pages to carry the authoritative status template. Current official pages for `Pride and Prejudice (1813)`, `Frankenstein, or the Modern Prometheus (Revised Edition, 1831)`, and `The Time Machine (Holt text)` were inspected, together with `Dracula` during the same audit.

Primary evidence:

- https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Wikisource:Licensing
- https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Pride_and_Prejudice_(1813)
- https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Frankenstein,_or_the_Modern_Prometheus_(Revised_Edition,_1831)
- https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Dracula
- https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/The_Time_Machine_(Holt_text)

**Decision:** admit a conservative WebNR-authored link-only starter. Do not infer a source-wide public-domain license, copy text/scans/exports, or add runtime MediaWiki polling. Any richer adapter must version pagination, revision identity, request cadence, limits/backoff, attribution, and per-work status fixtures.

### Project Runeberg — defer

Project Runeberg says it deliberately focuses on Nordic literature old enough to be out of copyright and marks editions that remain copyrighted with a warning. The project therefore has useful item-level rights signals but is not safe to flatten into a single source-wide reuse assumption.

Primary evidence:

- https://runeberg.org/admin/
- https://runeberg.org/admin/copyright.html

**Decision:** retain as a high-quality future discovery candidate. Require stable item fixtures that preserve the warning/right-status signal before any maintained catalog or adapter.

### StoryWeaver — defer richer adapter until media/attribution fixtures exist

StoryWeaver's current attribution guidance says stories and illustrations are CC BY 4.0 with a specific attribution line, while its open-content page separately states that ReadAlongs and videos use CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. The platform is therefore promising, but a correct adapter must distinguish media types and preserve the full attribution metadata.

Primary evidence:

- https://storyweaver.org.in/or/attributions
- https://storyweaver.org.in/en/open-content

**Decision:** defer integration until versioned fixtures prove storybook-versus-readalong/video classification, stable item identity, complete attribution fields, paging, size bounds, and request behavior.

### Perseus Digital Library — defer source-wide reuse

Perseus documents mixed rights across texts, translations, images, descriptions, and other materials. It exposes public-domain XML downloads and some openly licensed materials, but also carries special copyright agreements and explicitly prefers links over copying where rights vary.

Primary evidence:

- https://www.perseus.tufts.edu/hopper/help/copyright.jsp

**Decision:** keep as an item-specific link/discovery lead only. Do not admit a broad synchronized adapter without component-level rights fixtures.

### Lit2Go — defer

Lit2Go's current license permits up to 25 MP3/text files in a non-commercial educational project without special permission and prohibits commercial use without written permission.

Primary evidence:

- https://etc.usf.edu/lit2go/welcome/license/

**Decision:** do not ingest or redistribute Lit2Go files as a general WebNR source. A future authored link-only directory could be evaluated separately.

### Baen Free Library — defer

The current Baen Free Library exposes dozens of zero-price titles and says users may read or download the listed free-library books, while the surrounding modern store/cart/account surface remains distinct from a blanket redistribution license.

Primary evidence:

- https://www.baen.com/categories/free-library.html

**Decision:** research-only for now. Free access is not treated as permission for WebNR to redistribute modern copyrighted titles; any future integration must use exact item and current terms/access fixtures.

The starter stores basic bibliographic facts, authored descriptions, and verified English Wikisource landing-page URLs only.
